name: hesperia-workspace
description: Ergonomic Frontend Framework for building reactive web applications

scripts.test: bun run build && bun test --timeout=45000 tests/compiler tests/runtime tests/data tests/tooling tests/routing tests/editor tests/hosting tests/ci
scripts.test:package: bun run build && bun test --timeout=60000 tests/package
scripts.test:editor: bun run build && bun run --cwd editors/vscode typecheck && bun run --cwd editors/vscode build && bun run --cwd editors/vscode build:test && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File editors/vscode/test.ps1
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tests/package/fixtures/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tests/tooling/fixtures/drivers/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/create-hesperia/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun test --timeout=45000 tests/compiler tests/runtime tests/data tests/tooling tests/routing tests/editor tests/hosting tests/ci && bun run test:browser && bun test --timeout=60000 tests/package && bun run test:golden && bun run test:editor && bun run test:editor:installed
scripts.test:editor:installed: bun run build && bun scripts/ci/prepare-release-candidate.ts --candidate-dir .hesperia/release-candidate && bun run package:editor && bun run --cwd editors/vscode build:test && bun scripts/ci/test-editor-package.ts
